audit_source: scripts/update-meetings.js + live HEAD probes of each council's calendar URL
context: 8 councils had empty meetings.json after the 12 April 2026 cron run. Issue 3 (push race) prevented refresh for 4 subsequent weeks. This audit determines which of the 8 will refill once the cron is fixed vs which need additional scraper work.

durham.calendar_probe: HTTP 200, 0 'Meeting of' matches in May 2026 calendar
durham.root_cause: Possibly empty calendar window (Durham council in pre-election purdah May 1-7 2026), OR ModernGov calendar path differs. Probably self-resolves at next refresh, but verify.
durham.action: Re-probe after next successful cron run. If still 0, investigate Durham's actual calendar URL (try /mgCalendarMonthView.aspx).

north_northants.calendar_probe: HTTP 200, 100 'Meeting of' matches in May 2026 calendar
north_northants.root_cause: Calendar is healthy. Empty meetings.json is the result of the 12 April cron + 4 subsequent push-race failures. Will self-heal once Issue 3 fix lands.
north_northants.action: No code change needed. Re-run cron.

west_northants.calendar_probe: HTTP 200, 100 'Meeting of' matches in May 2026 calendar
west_northants.root_cause: Same as N Northants — healthy upstream, cron-blocked.

warwickshire_cc.calendar_probe: HTTP 200, 93 'Meeting of' matches in May 2026 calendar

nottinghamshire_cc.calendar_probe: HTTP 404 on mgCalendarAgendaView.aspx — the URL is broken because Notts CC runs CMIS, NOT ModernGov
nottinghamshire_cc.evidence: https://www.nottinghamshire.gov.uk/dms/ exposes CMISHome.aspx, Meetings.aspx, Committees.aspx — classic CMIS endpoints
nottinghamshire_cc.root_cause: Wrong platform classification. update-meetings.js scrapeCouncil() can't handle CMIS — needs a new scraper or a switch to find a real ModernGov instance (none known).
nottinghamshire_cc.action: Add scrapeCMISCouncil() function. CMIS exposes Meetings.aspx?meet=N or a similar pattern; needs investigation. Or: try the third-party CMIS Public View if Notts uses one.

derbyshire_cc.calendar_probe: HTTP 200, 85 'Meeting of' matches in May 2026 calendar
derbyshire_cc.root_cause: Same as N Northants — healthy upstream, cron-blocked.

staffordshire_cc.calendar_probe: 302 redirect to https://staffordshire.moderngov.co.uk, then HTTP 200 with 101 'Meeting of' matches
staffordshire_cc.root_cause: Domain migration not reflected in scraper config. The configured URL works via redirect — but if Node fetch doesn't follow 302, scraper may bail.
staffordshire_cc.action: Update moderngov_url to 'https://staffordshire.moderngov.co.uk' in update-meetings.js (one-line fix). Verify fetch follows redirects.

lancashire_pcc.root_cause: Per scraper comments at scripts/update-meetings.js:210-216: 'no structured meetings calendar; only topic-aggregator pages per scrutiny panel'.
lancashire_pcc.action: Either build a Playwright-based scraper for the OPCC topic pages, OR accept the empty meetings.json. Low priority — election not until May 2028.

immediate_next_actions: Patch Staffs URL to staffordshire.moderngov.co.uk in scripts/update-meetings.js
Re-probe Durham after cron run — if still 0, deeper investigation
Schedule CMIS scraper work for nottinghamshire_cc (1-2 day task)

cohort_extensions_added.cmis_note: These 9 councils run CMIS (cmis.uk.com hosted or council-hosted) rather than ModernGov. Adding a scrapeCMISCouncil() function to scripts/update-meetings.js is the next maintenance task. CMIS exposes meeting listings via Meetings.aspx?meet=N + a JSON-style attendance feed (varies per council). Estimated 1 day of work to handle the 3-4 most common CMIS variants.
